questions.q: Identify the error: “The scissors is lying on the table near the lamp.”
questions.why: 'Scissors' is a plural-only noun: 'are lying'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “I cannot help to laugh at his jokes.”
opts: I cannot help laugh at his jokes.
I cannot but laughing at his jokes.
I cannot helping laugh at his jokes.
I cannot help laughing at his jokes.
questions.why: 'Cannot help' is followed by a gerund. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct transformation: “No other city in India is as large as Mumbai.” (comparative degree)
opts: Mumbai is larger than any other city in India.
Mumbai is the largest than other cities in India.
Mumbai is larger than any city in India.
Mumbai is as large as any other city in India.
questions.why: Positive → comparative with 'any other'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “a blessing in disguise”:
opts: something that seems bad but turns out good

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: The nurse said to the patient, “Have you taken your tablets?”
opts: The nurse asked the patient if he has taken his tablets.
The nurse asked the patient that had he taken his tablets.
The nurse asked the patient whether he had taken his tablets.
The nurse asked the patient whether had he taken his tablets.
questions.why: Yes/no questions use 'if/whether' with statement word order and backshift. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “By next March, they ______ the new hospital wing.”
questions.why: An action finished before a future time: future perfect. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “I am grateful ____ you for your timely help.”
questions.why: 'Grateful to' a person, 'for' a thing. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct option: “Scarcely had I reached home ______ it started raining.”
Choose the one word for: “A person who hates mankind”
questions.why: A misanthrope dislikes and distrusts people in general. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Spot the error: “Unless you do not submit the form, you cannot sit the exam.”
questions.why: 'Unless' already means 'if not'; drop 'do not'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.
